title: Find Users with Persistent Behavior Patterns
summary: SQL: activity(user_id,action_date,action), unique by all three fields. Find runs of at least five consecutive dates on which a user performs exactly one action and that action is constant throughout the run. For each user choose the longest run, then lexicographically smallest action, then latest start date. Return user_id,action,streak_length,start_date,end_date sorted by length descending then user_id ascending. A date with multiple action types breaks a run.
officialConstraints: user_id integer, action_date date, action text; primary key includes all fields.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
